description: A single LED package with independent red, green, and blue elements, plus one shared pin.
how_to_use: R/G/B are each a separate color channel (not interchangeable with each other — swapping which color goes where changes what the diagram actually does). COM is the shared pin: common anode (tie to 5V/3V3) by default, or common cathode (tie to GND) if the `common` attribute is set — check which mode a given diagram uses before assuming COM's role.

plain.what: Three little lights — red, green and blue — in one. Mix them to make almost any colour.
plain.how: This one is 'common anode': the longest leg goes to 5V. Each of the other three legs goes through its own resistor to its own Arduino pin — and a colour lights when its pin is LOW.

pins.R: red cathode (−) — through a resistor to its pin
pins.COM: the longest leg: the common anode (+), to 5V
